sources.title: zeroweight-ai/ZeroTTS · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ZeroTTS's time-to-first-audio comes from its real streaming path — first audio frame, not first full utterance. The three baselines have no working CPU streaming path, so their TTFA is the time to the complete utterance. A voice is a small array of speaker latents, (1, n_voice_queries, d_model), shipped as a .npz under voices/. That array is the entire speaker conditioning — no reference transcript, no audio prompt.
